blocks.text: Jab system mein heat di jaye to temperature barhne, dabao barhne ya halat badalne ki wajah se internal energy mein izafa hota hai. Agar saath hi madde ko phail kar apne mahol par kaam karne diya jaye to darkar heat Q woh heat hogi jo madde ki internal energy ko pehli halat U1 se doosri halat U2 tak badalne ko chahiye, jama mahol par kiya kaam W: Q = (U2 - U1) + W, ya Q = delta U + W ... (6.5). Yun internal energy ki tabdeeli delta U = U2 - U1 Q - W ke taur par bayan hoti hai. Chunke yeh halat se mutalliq sab amal ke liye ek si hai, pehla qanoon yun bayan ho sakta hai:

blocks.title: Thermodynamics ka pehla qanoon
blocks.text: Kisi bhi thermodynamic amal mein, jab system ko heat Q di jaye to yeh energy system mein mehfooz internal energy ke izafe delta U jama system ke apne mahol par kiye kaam W ke taur par zahir hoti hai.

items: Baqa ka usool: pehle qanoon ka bunyadi usool energy ka baqa hai. Yeh kehta hai ke energy ek shakal se doosri mein badal sakti hai (jaise chemical potential energy se thermal energy), magar isolated system mein energy ki kul miqdar waqt ke saath mustaqil rehti hai.

Wasee itlaq: mechanical systems se aage pehla qanoon energy ki sab shakalon aur sab qism ke amal par lagu hai, jin mein chemical reactions, electrical systems aur nuclear reactions shamil hain; yeh woh bunyadi samajh deta hai jo scientists aur engineers ko mukhtalif soorton mein energy ki tabdeeliyon ki peshgoi aur samajh deti hai.

blocks.text: Pehla qanoon energy ke baqa ka qanoon bayan karta hai, yeh tasdeeq karte hue ke isolated systems mein energy baqi rehne wali miqdar hai; yeh samajhne ka dhancha deta hai ke systems ke andar energy kaise muntaqil aur tabdeel hoti hai, is bunyadi usool ki khilaf-warzi ke baghair ke energy na banai ja sakti hai na mitai. Nishanon ke qaide (For Your Information): system mein heat +Q, system se bahar heat -Q, system par kiya kaam -W, system ka kiya kaam +W.

Cycle ka pump achhi misal hai: jab hum handle ko tezi se dabate hain to gas par kiye mechanical kaam ki wajah se woh garam ho jata hai, us ki internal energy barhti hui. Fig. 6.6 ke intizam mein cycle ke pump ka outlet band hai; band outlet se jura thermocouple hawa ka temperature dekhne deta hai. Jab piston tezi se dhakela jaye to thermometer hawa ki internal energy barhne se temperature mein izafa dikhata hai: dhakke ki force hawa par kaam karti hai, us ki internal energy barhati hui, jo hawa ke temperature ke izafe se zahir hoti hai. Insani metabolism bhi energy ke baqa ki misal deta hai: insan aur doosre janwar chalne, daurne ya hilne par kaam karte hain; kaam ko energy chahiye, aur energy barhne, naye cells banane aur mare hue purane cells badalne ko bhi chahiye. Jandar ke andar energy badalne wale amal metabolism kehlate hain. Pehla qanoon (delta U = Q - W) insani jism jaise jandar par lagane se kiya kaam jism ki internal energy ghatata hai; nateejatan jism ka temperature, yani internal energy, hamare khane se qaim rehti hai.

blocks.title: Example 6.2
blocks.text: Gas 0.10 m^2 cross-sectional raqbe ke piston wale bartan mein band hai; gas ka dabao 8000 N m^-2 par qaim rakha jata hai. Jab heat aahista di jaye to piston 4.0 cm oopar dhakela jata hai. Agar phailao ke doran system ko 42 J heat di jaye to system ki internal energy ki tabdeeli kya hai? Hal: gas ka kiya kaam W = P delta V = P A delta y = 8000 N m^-2 x 0.10 m^2 x 4.0 x 10^-2 m = 32 N m = 32 J. Internal energy ki tabdeeli pehle qanoon se: delta U = Q - W = 42 J - 32 J = 10 J.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: pehla qanoon apne nishanon ke qaide ke saath chaar chhote system boxes aur do usoolon ke taur par, Example 6.2 ke saath. Oopar darmiyan: band outlet, thermocouple aur millivoltmeter wala cycle ka pump, aur insani metabolism ki misal. Oopar daen: P-V diagram par isotherm aur us se khari adiabat. Neeche: isothermal aur adiabatic amal bayan, reversible aur irreversible amal aur cycles.
blocks.caption: Thermodynamics ka pehla qanoon, isothermal aur adiabatic amal, reversibility (Figures 6.6 aur 6.7 aur topics 6.4 aur 6.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: System ko di heat juz-wi taur par us ki internal energy barhane aur juz-wi taur par us kaam mein jati hai jo system apne mahol par karta hai, heat in aur work out musbat gine hue; qanoon energy ka baqa hai aur har qism ke amal par lagu hai, jaisa piston dabane par garam hota cycle ka pump aur khane se chalta jism dono dikhate hain. Isothermal tabdeeli mein ideal gas ka temperature aur is liye internal energy mustaqil rehti hai, di gayi sari heat kaam banti hai, tabdeeli aahista honi chahiye, aur P-V curve isotherm naami hyperbola hai. Adiabatic tabdeeli mein koi heat ka tabadla nahi, kaam internal energy ke kharch par hota hai to phailne par temperature girta aur dabne par barhta hai, tabdeeli tez ya insulated hai, aur zyada khari P-V curve adiabat hai. Reversible amal mahol mein koi tabdeeli chhore baghair bilkul wapas chalaya ja sakta hai, jaisa aahista compression taqreeban kar sakta hai; achanak tabdeeliyan, raghrat aur dissipation amal ko irreversible banate hain.

blocks.text: Isothermal amal mustaqil temperature par hota hai, to gas par Boyle ka qanoon lagane ki shart poori hoti hai: jab gas isothermal taur par phaile ya dabe to us ke dabao aur volume ka hasil-e-zarb mustaqil rehta hai. Agar P1, V1 ibtidai dabao aur volume aur P2, V2 isothermal tabdeeli ke baad ke hon (Fig. 6.7a), P1 V1 = P2 V2. Ideal gas ke liye us ke molecules se juri PE sifr hai, to internal energy sirf us ke temperature par munhasir hai, jo yahan mustaqil rehta hai; is liye delta U = 0 aur pehla qanoon Q = W ban jata hai. Yun agar gas phail kar bahri kaam W kare to isothermal tabdeeli paida karne ko gas ko heat Q deni parti hai. Chunke heat ki ek jagah se doosri jagah muntaqili ko waqt chahiye, temperature mustaqil rakhne ko phailao ya compression aahista hona chahiye. Isothermal amal zahir karne wala curve isotherm hai. (Brain Teaser: isothermal phailao mein ideal gas ki internal energy mustaqil kyun rehti hai? Kyunke yeh sirf temperature par munhasir hai.)

Adiabatic amal woh hai jis mein koi heat system mein dakhil ya bahar nahi hoti; is liye Q = 0 aur pehla qanoon W = -delta U deta hai. Yun agar gas phail kar bahri kaam kare to yeh us ke molecules ki internal energy ke kharch par hota hai aur gas ka temperature girta hai; is ke ulat adiabatic compression gas par kiye kaam ki wajah se gas ka temperature barhata hai. Adiabatic tabdeeli tab hoti hai jab gas tezi se phaile ya dabe, khaas kar jab gas insulated cylinder mein ho. Adiabatic amal ki misalein: phate tyre se hawa ka tez nikalna; hawa ka tez phailao aur compression jis se sound wave guzar rahi ho; fiza mein badalon ka banna. Chunke gas ka temperature mustaqil nahi rehta, P V^gamma = mustaqil, jahan gamma gas ki mustaqil dabao par molar specific heat ki mustaqil volume par molar specific heat se nisbat hai. Adiabatic amal zahir karne wala curve adiabat hai (Fig. 6.7b), isotherm se zyada khara.

blocks.caption: Isothermal ke muqable adiabatic
rows: phailne par girta, dabne par barhta

blocks.prompt: Gas 500 J heat jazb karti aur 300 J kaam karti hai; us ki internal energy ki tabdeeli nikalein (numerical 6.3). Adiabat isotherm se zyada khara kyun hai, aur adiabatic taur par phailti gas ke temperature aur dabao ka kya hota hai (short question 6.6; constructed response 6.3)?
blocks.explanation: delta U = Q - W = 500 - 300 = 200 J. Adiabatic phailao mein dabao volume barhne aur temperature girne dono ki wajah se girta hai, jabke isothermal phailao mein sirf volume ka asar hai, to adiabat tez girta hai: gamma 1 se bare ke saath P V^gamma ke muqable PV. Adiabatic taur par phailte hue gas apni internal energy se kaam karti hai, to us ka temperature girta hai aur dabao isothermal tabdeeli se zyada tezi se girta hai.

items: Pehla qanoon: Q = delta U + W; heat in +Q, out -Q; kaam by +W, on -W; har amal ke liye energy ka baqa (dabane par cycle ka pump garam; jism ki internal energy khane se qaim). Example 6.2: W = 32 J, delta U = 10 J.

Isothermal: T mustaqil, PV = mustaqil, delta U = 0, Q = W, aahista, isotherm. Adiabatic: Q = 0, W = -delta U, P V^gamma = mustaqil, tez ya insulated (phata tyre, sound wave, badal banna), adiabat zyada khara.
